readMe.a: Account Field Health & Tech Debt Analysis — SBU

readMe.b: Identify which Account fields are genuinely in use and which are tech debt, using measured record-level population rather than estimates.
Live Salesforce metadata (describe, FieldDefinition, Tooling CustomField) read directly from SBU production (posnation.my.salesforce.com) on 2026-11-10.

Created Date, Created By, Last Modified, Help Text and Description come from a fresh live Tooling CustomField read on 2026-11-10 for fields that have a CustomField row (custom and managed-package fields). Standard fields with no CustomField row show null/No for these.

Live SOQL aggregates against SBU production (org 00D40000000N194EAC, POS Nation) on 2026-11-10. No record export. Population, recency and trend numbers are exact counts over every Account as of today, not a sample.
339 of 356 live Account fields assessed (8 Long Text Area fields not assessable; 4 invalid/non-queryable fields excluded; 5 compound address parent fields excluded).

Checkbox/Formula(Checkbox) fields measure population as the TRUE count, not non-null count (checkboxes default false and are never null). Multi-select picklists measure non-null (any value selected) via a != null filter since SOQL COUNT() does not support multi-select picklist fields directly.

Unlike the Case pull, the eligible-since-creation denominator is computed EXACTLY for every Account field regardless of age, because the full 151-month Account record history (back to 2014-05) was collected, not just a 24-month lookback. Only the populated-since-creation numerator still falls back to all-time population (and the denominator to the full Account history) for fields created before the 24-month monthly-trend window (2024-11), since per-field monthly population was only sampled back to that window. For fields created within the trend window, since-creation figures are computed exactly from the monthly series.

Measured exactly (capped at 5, the scoring model's full-credit threshold) for all picklist-type fields via GROUP BY sampling. Non-picklist high-cardinality field types (dates, numbers, free text, lookups) default to 5 (full credit) without a per-field query, since they are reliably high-cardinality.

readMe.a: Reference counts not measured this round
readMe.b: Flow, formula, layout and other reference counts (flows, formulaRefs, layouts, otherRefs, totalRefs, refTypes) were NOT measured for Account fields in this pass. The Tooling API MetadataComponentDependency object does not support COUNT() aggregation, and a raw-row dependency pull across the roughly 290 aggregatable/custom Account fields was judged too costly and unreliable to attempt this round. Every field therefore shows 0 for these columns. This means "Verify formula usage" and "Retire candidate" classifications for Account are based on population and recency signals ONLY — a field showing 0 references has NOT been confirmed absent from flows, formulas, layouts or integrations elsewhere in the org; it simply was not checked this round.
